Definition: from G2819 and the base of G3551 (in its original sense of partitioning, i.e. (reflexively) getting by apportionment); a sharer by lot, i.e. inheritor (literally or figuratively); by implication, a possessor:--heir.
KeyPassages: Matthew 21:38; Mark 12:7; Luke 20:14; Romans 4:13; Galatians 3:29; Titus 3:7
BiblicalUsage: Kleronomos is the heir. Matthew 21:38 and Mark 12:7 and Luke 20:14 all show the husbandmen plotting against the heir, Romans 4:13 says the promise that Abraham should be the heir of the world was not through the law but through the righteousness of faith, Galatians 3:29 says, if ye be Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise, and Titus 3:7 says we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the heir is whoever belongs to Christ: the husbandmen tried to kill the heir and seize the inheritance, but the promise went to Abraham's seed by faith. I hold that Galatians 3:29 is the open door, because if I am Christ's, I am an heir.
RelatedBooks: Matthew; Mark; Luke; Romans; Galatians; Titus
